name: Lumibird SA
summary: Lumibird SA designs, manufactures, and sells various lasers for scientific, industrial, and medical applications in France, Hong Kong, the United States, Germany, South Korea, China, and Austria. The company operates through Photonics and Medical divisions. It offers fiber lasers and amplifiers, high power fiber lasers, and solid-state lasers, laser diodes and components; and doppler wind LiDAR, time-of-flight LiDAR and rangefinders, military laser rangefinders, and medical and ophthalmological solutions.
